title: The agent-generated connector
prompt: The Connector Builder generated a connector, and its mocked tests pass. In review, you see every document set to allow_all_datasource_users_access. What do you do?

options.text: Reject it: map real ACLs and identities, then pass the recorded phase.
options.feedback: Right. An allow-all default is the most consequential thing to miss, and the recorded phase rejects it because it prevents proving denial.

options.text: Accept it: the mocked tests passed.
options.feedback: Mocked tests check transform output, not denial. Review permissions before trusting generated code.

options.text: Ship it and tighten the ACLs after launch.
options.feedback: Never index sensitive content with an allow-all ACL for now.

takeaway: Generated code gets the same review as yours.
